MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The self-drilling screws fit my repeated interest in fasteners for repair and assembly, provided their size suits the materials I am joining.",
    "Disposable gloves have a plausible use in messy workshop tasks, although I would check their chemical compatibility before using them with epoxy."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Printer filament assumes a printing setup and an active project that my recent purchases do not establish; buying fabrication tools does not mean I currently need printing supplies.",
    "Decorative filament colors and finishes do not solve an identified repair need, and a printer itself requires a clearer purpose before I would choose it.",
    "Deck screws relate to my woodworking interests, but this particular length and large quantity need a matching project before they become useful."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in making and repairing things seems to have been stretched into an assumed interest in 3D printing.",
    "Several filament choices repeat the same unsupported assumption; changing the color or material does not give me a reason to need filament."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of rivets, threaded inserts, bolts, nuts and screws point toward joining materials and assembling parts.",
    "Practical fit matters: fastener dimensions, material compatibility and quantities must suit the job, even when the general product type interests me.",
    "My measurement, inspection and cutting tools suggest ongoing hands-on repair work, which gives related workshop supplies a clearer purpose than decorative printing materials."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my workshop interests but assumed a 3D printing need where my history more clearly supports fastening, repair and assembly."
}
